Articles and nouns 159
un festival a festival des festivals festivals
un œil an eye des yeux eyes
un bijou a jewel des bijoux jewels
In French, no -s is added to a family name used in the plural. You’ll refer to Monsieur et
Madame Renaud as les Renaud.
